cases.label: open the test, run it, see it pass

lines: import { Money } from "./money";
export function refundAmount(paid: Money, used: number): Money {
const share = 1 - used / 100;
// round to whole cents before returning
return paid.times(share).round(2);
import { refundAmount } from "./refund";
import { Money } from "./money";
test("refunds the unused share", () => {
const paid = Money.of("49.99");
expect(refundAmount(paid, 30).toString()).toBe("34.99");
"name": "billing-service",

cases.label: step through a function in the debugger

lines: def tier_discount(total, tier):
rates = {"silver": 0.05, "gold": 0.1}
rate = rates.get(tier, 0)
if total > 500:
rate += 0.02
# never discount below cost
return round(total * (1 - rate), 2)
from pricing.discount import tier_discount
print(tier_discount(620, "gold"))
